metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC, navigated to Tools > Preferences > Input/Codecs, clicked Browse to select the Desktop folder as the recording directory, then clicked Save.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC menus, open Simple Preferences dialog, browse filesystem dialogs, select folders, and save settings.
metadata.explanation: Direct replication of the source trajectory goal. Evaluator reads /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc and checks that record-path equals /home/user/Desktop after the agent saves preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: Baseline variation that validates the evaluator pattern against the proved-successful trajectory. No step-by-step guidance given since model demonstrated it can navigate VLC preferences independently.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc, which is the standard VLC config file on Linux.
Getter uses the correct key 'record-path' that VLC writes for the recording directory setting.
Metric performs exact string comparison (with trailing slash normalization) against '/home/user/Desktop', which correctly corresponds to the Desktop folder for the 'user' account.
Error handling is appropriate: if the key is absent (default/unsaved state), getter returns {'record_path': None} and metric returns 0.0, providing good negative-control resistance.
The trajectory confirms VLC writes 'record-path=/home/user/Desktop' to vlcrc after the user saves preferences, so the getter will capture the saved state correctly.
Evaluator fully covers the single instruction requirement (change recording folder to Desktop) with no missing checks.
